title: SimplexUQ: An Evaluation Framework and Benchmark for Conformal Uncertainty on Simplex-Valued Predictions
abstract: arXiv:2610.00523v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conformal prediction guarantees marginal coverage, but a single calibration threshold can still spread that coverage unevenly, over-covering easy regions and under-covering hard ones. SimplexUQ is, to our knowledge, the first benchmark and reproducible protocol for measuring this allocation problem on simplex-valued predictions; it compares existing conformal wrappers rather than proposing a new one. Its task suite, SimplexTasks-12, combines six controlled synthetic regimes with six frozen-predictor real tasks spanning class probabilities, topic mixtures, spectral abundances, cell-type fractions, age distributions, and emotion mixtures. Each comparison fixes the predictor, score, and response-free stratification map, varies only the wrapper, and reports marginal coverage, worst-stratum coverage, max disparity, and within-task radius and compute. Global calibration can look valid while failing badly: on CIFAR-10 it attains 0.900 marginal

translated_title: SimplexUQ：面向单纯形值预测保形不确定性的评估框架与基准
translated_abstract: 保形预测能够保证边际覆盖率，但单一的校准阈值仍可能使覆盖率分布不均衡，对简单区域过度覆盖，而对困难区域覆盖不足。据我们所知，SimplexUQ 是首个针对单纯形值预测上这一覆盖率分配问题而设计的基准测试与可复现评估协议；它比较现有的保形包装器，而非提出新的包装器。其任务套件 SimplexTasks-12 由六个受控合成场景和六个冻结预测器的真实任务组成，涵盖类别概率、主题混合、光谱丰度、细胞类型比例、年龄分布和情感混合等场景。每次比较均固定预测器、分数函数以及与响应无关的分层映射，仅改变包装器，并报告边际覆盖率、最差分层覆盖率、最大差异以及任务内区间半径与计算开销。全局校准可能看似有效实则表现糟糕：在 CIFAR-10 上，它达到了 0.900 的边际覆盖率（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: SimplexUQ 是首个用于评估单纯形值预测上保形预测覆盖率分配问题的基准与可复现协议，通过固定预测器仅对比现有保形包装器，揭示了全局校准看似有效但对困难区域覆盖不足的问题。
en_tdlr: SimplexUQ is the first benchmark and reproducible protocol for evaluating the coverage allocation problem of conformal prediction on simplex-valued predictions, comparing existing conformal wrappers under fixed predictors and revealing that global calibration can appear valid while severely under-covering hard regions.
